## Description and Rationale

I'm a software engineering student at the University of Canterbury in New Zealand who enjoys messy, real-world data problems. Taxi-out prediction looked like a great way to learn through an open-science challenge!

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: New Zealand
* Number of team members: 1
